scope: Remaining Verenian focus and national-spirit palette guidance only; not an inventory, approval record, binding manifest or image-generation result.

snapshot.basis: 511 main briefs plus 49 native briefs; exclude 54 main-brief targets present in approved batch manifests and bound to GFX_HSM_VER_ART_ in definitions at inspection. Two earlier integrated focuses were already absent from main briefs.

precedence: Exact canonical flag pixels and composition
Explicit colors and exclusions in source_brief
Category direction as a restrained overall balance
Compatible stock material colors only, never unrelated stock symbols
rules.application: Apply each material rule only to the listed existing objects, not to the whole icon. Rules are conditional material choices, not extra props. Category swatches are a selection, not a requirement to use every color. Do not add a background, uniform rim, badge or branch-wide tint. Color cannot replace the distinct semantic silhouette in source_brief.
rules.surface: Painted HOI4-compatible objects, transparent exterior. Focus readability at 99x86; spirits at 64x64. Use value separation and sparse edge highlights, not universal gold outlines or cobalt shadows. Keep one dominant silhouette and at most two supporting motifs as already briefed.
rules.materials_not_heraldry: Swatch hex values are proposed material/art-direction choices, not canonical state colors. Green crops/enamel, red cloth, brass hardware and ivory paper do not imply a flag, party or dynasty. Metallic gold only for justified small fittings; ripe grain is matte straw, not gold.
rules.no_new_lore: Do not import stock human hands/fists, arbitrary crowns, lilies, Soviet symbols, Foundation insignia, national seals or aircraft roundels. No human anatomy. Keep all original semantic exclusions; no blank documents or pseudo-text. Existing diagrams remain concrete.
rules.variation: Different categories and object materials carry color variety. Paired language bindings may contrast sage, russet and plum without assigning national identities. Same physical material may recur across branches; do not impose a shared badge.
rules.flag_preservation: When a brief requires a flag, use the exact reference composition and source colors, without crop, mirror, substituted emblem or generic color normalization. No flag is added merely because a reference is available.
rules.status: This is a fixed inspection snapshot. Before production reconcile completed IDs read-only against later approved batches; do not overwrite the pinned inventory or briefs.

inspection.method: Existing sprite textures viewed in in-memory contact sheets; four canonical flag PNGs viewed separately. No images generated or changed. Other resolved originals were not visually reviewed.
hazards: Stock icons frequently depict unrelated objects; their colors and symbols are not binding lore.
Human hands/fists in scientific, liberty and court placeholders must not migrate into new art.
Royal/imperial names do not authorize crowns; existing throne/dais briefs deliberately exclude unverified regalia.
Crimson also appears on authoritarian drapery; it is not an automatic communist marker.
No palette guidance changes gameplay, sprite bindings or art approval.

Light enamel bodies, grey steel fittings; glass muted turquoise #6F9F99 and contacts copper #AD7953. No luminous cyan halo.

Pewter/grey metal currency and mechanism; dark iron strongboxes, green felt #55735F only on existing lining. Do not invent coin arms.
Linen white and muted green glass #7BA494, dark metal supports. Do not add a red-cross emblem.
Aluminium structure, charcoal mechanisms and olive fabric #7B8061 where appropriate; no invented roundels or flags.
Muted green machine paint over iron, silver worn edges and near-black rubber. Civil machines need not use army camouflage.
Iron bodies with local aged brass #AA925C on optical rings or bells; glass pale grey-green. Amber light only for explicitly lit lamps.
Muted burgundy textile, unless the source brief explicitly specifies another color; not an invented party or national color.
Soot-dark iron and exposed grey metal; copper pipe #A17350 only where plausible. Glowing crucible alone permits amber #D58A42.
Stone/concrete neutral grey, earth muted umber #776F59 and timber #A09275; existing brick may be muted terracotta. No colored decorative backdrop.
Storage grey-green enamel or worn timber #9B8C70; paper and drawings ivory #E5DFCF. Keep distinct tabs sage/russet/plum without assigning nations.
